description: This file defines an abstract Android activity class 'TabCompatActivity' that manages tab functionality via a 'TabHelper'. It handles lifecycle methods for saving and restoring state and provides access to the TabHelper instance. It facilitates compatibility across Android API levels for tab UI implementations.

classes.name: TabCompatActivity
classes.description: An abstract activity providing tab compatibility support using TabHelper, extending FragmentActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes TabHelper instance during activity creation.

methods.name: getTabHelper
methods.description: Returns the TabHelper instance, ensuring it is set up.
